mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,resource_id FROM api_idempotency_record WHERE scope_tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE api_idempotency_record SET processing_status='SUCCEEDED',resource_id=#{resourceId} WHERE scope_tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND processing_status='PROCESSING'
